_doc: Everything a player can start from the camp. All of them pay into the same character through Progression.award: nothing resets between activities. requires gates on renown and earlier clears; teaches are weaves handed over outright (the training yard only); shows are weaves the character sees woven there, which halves the study they take and they can then learn. grants are techniques (tie_off) learned the first time it is cleared. kind: training | holdout | mission | spar.

camp_training.name: Training yard
camp_training.blurb: Novice exercises at the camp: weave at the practice posts.

tarwins_gap_watch.name: Tarwin's Gap: the watch
tarwins_gap_watch.blurb: A raiding fist comes down the pass at dusk. Hold the line.

wagon_ring.name: The wagon ring
wagon_ring.blurb: A merchant train caught in open hills, wagons drawn into a ring. They come from every side, with archers, and an Eyeless leads them.

wild_hunt.name: The Wild Hunt
wild_hunt.blurb: Something has your trail: hounds that leave their prints in stone, a thing that sings from the dark, and one who channels for the Shadow.

darkfriend.name: A Darkfriend among us
darkfriend.blurb: Hold the ring, together. One of you may serve the Shadow. Find them, kill them or hold them, and live to the end.

endless.name: Tarwin's Gap: the endless night
endless.blurb: They never stop coming. Last thirty minutes and you have won; how long past that is up to you.

short_watch.name: Tarwin's Gap: a short watch (tests)
short_watch.blurb: Three waves and done: the old watch, kept for the tests and the tour.

practice.name: Practice ground (tests)
practice.blurb: The training yard without its rolls: a fixed sandbox for the rules tests.

dream_spar.name: Sparring in Tel'aran'rhiod
dream_spar.blurb: Duel a friend in the World of Dreams. Nothing here can truly harm you.

team_battle.name: Two banners
team_battle.blurb: Two sides meet round a ring of wagons. Kill those under the other banner, ten deaths wins, or the most when twelve minutes run out. Shadowspawn come for both.

tarwins_day.label: Tarwin's Gap
tarwins_day.blurb: A raiding fist comes down the pass at dusk. Hold the breastwork.

tarwins_night.label: Tarwin's Gap by night
tarwins_night.blurb: The pass by watch-fire light, and worse than Trollocs in the dark.

wagon_ring.label: The wagon ring
wagon_ring.blurb: A merchant train caught in open hills, wagons drawn into a ring. They come from every side.

wild_hunt.label: The Wild Hunt
wild_hunt.blurb: Open ground, and the Shadow's hunters: Darkhounds, a Draghkar, Dreadlords.

holdout.name: Hold the line
holdout.blurb: Waves for twenty to thirty minutes. Where, and what comes, is chosen as you walk up.

darkfriend_door.name: A Darkfriend among us
darkfriend_door.blurb: Waves, and perhaps a traitor among you. Somewhere random.

endless_door.name: The endless night
endless_door.blurb: Waves without end. Thirty minutes is a win. Somewhere random.

guard_door.name: Guard the Aes Sedai
guard_door.blurb: An Aes Sedai seals a Waygate, and cannot lift a hand while she weaves. Seven minutes. They want her above all; if she falls, it is lost.

guard.name: An Aes Sedai of the Brown
